name: Ideas & Notes
description: Organize a solo recording of thoughts, personal notes, or brainstorming without turning ideas into commitments.

sections.title: Overview
sections.instruction: Summarize the thoughts or topics the speaker was trying to capture. Keep the speaker's uncertainty and tone without treating this as a meeting or a finished plan.

sections.title: Ideas & Observations
sections.instruction: List the ideas, observations, examples, and possibilities worth remembering. Keep tentative possibilities separate from decisions or commitments.

sections.title: Open Questions
sections.instruction: List questions or tensions the speaker raised and did not resolve. Omit this section if none were raised.

sections.title: Action Items
sections.instruction: List only actions the speaker explicitly decided or committed to take. Do not turn ideas to explore into tasks; omit this section when there is no clear commitment.
